dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: If only we could find a way to increase the cabin capacity...

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Wouldn't that affect the ship's hull though?

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: At least, simply changing the material wouldn't cut it.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But based on my calculations, if this cabin here could be opened up to the one next door...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But you said that wouldn't work, so maybe it really isn't possible...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, does everyone in Liyue know as much about ships as you do, Qishan?

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Ahem... Not necessarily.

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: After all, we have people working in all sorts of industries in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Hi, need some commercial ship repairs done?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I'm a ship craftsman. I'm responsible for ship repairs and maintenance.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: When there's no work to do, I'll carry out new research on such questions as how to expand a ship's cabin capacity without compromising the structural integrity of the hull...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But I'm no researcher after all. I don't have a lot of theoretical knowledge, no means to conduct experiments, and I have no friends who study in Kshahrewar...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I've submitted a request to the Akasha Terminal, but it seems to believe that I know enough already...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: With regards to my daily work alone, it is indeed enough. But I really want to make some new breakthroughs...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Okay. Come find me if you do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I'm the ship's craftsman. I'm responsible for ship repairs and maintenance.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: When there's no work to do, I'll carry out new research on such questions as how to expand a ship's cabin capacity without compromising the structural integrity of its hull...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But in the end, I'm no researcher. I don't have a lot of theoretical knowledge, no means to conduct experiments, and I have no friends who study in Kshahrewar, and now that Akasha has been shut down...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But Qishan says that this may not be a bad thing. Now that the Akasha Terminals are gone, she says, everyone is free to obtain whatever knowledge they desire.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: And you know what? I think she's got a point there!
